question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Glory
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Glory"** means high renown or honor won by notable achievements. (महिमा)

 
 
• **Example: **The athlete basked in the glory of his Olympic victory.
 
 
 
• **"Shame" **refers to a painful feeling of humiliation or distress caused by the consciousness of wrong or foolish behavior. (शर्म)
 
 
• **Example: **He felt deep shame after being caught cheating on the exam.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Glory' **is **'Shame'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Delight **(आनंद): Great pleasure.

 
 
• **Example:** The children screamed with delight when they saw the ice cream truck.
 
 
 
• **Honour **(सम्मान ): High respect; great esteem.
 
 
• **Example: **He received an award in honor of his contributions to the field.
 
 
 
• **Gluttony** (पेटूपन): Habitual greed or excess in eating.
 
 
• **Example:** His gluttony at the buffet was embarrassing to watch.
